mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates stronger underlying demand for residential construction, which correlates with robust corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1300, or the Rank IC over 12 months is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.0% indicates an active monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 12 months is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE below 4.0%) and high consumer spending (RSAFS above 500,000) indicates a strong labor market and robust consumer demand, which together generate positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days with multiplicative effect.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05 in regression) or the Rank IC for the combined signal is below 0.02 over a 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 250), a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 1.5%) indicates aggressive monetary tightening, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 250), negative returns are not observed when FEDFUNDS > 1.5% (Rank IC < 0.02 or average return positive).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which correlates with reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC over 12 months is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates elevated inflation, which typically leads to higher interest rates and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL and SPX returns is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) indicates a tight labor market that supports strong consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 12 months is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a combination of high housing starts (HOUST > 1300) and strong payroll growth (PAYEMS > 152000) indicates robust consumer demand and corporate earnings momentum, which together drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05 in regression) or the Rank IC for the combined signal is below 0.02 over a 12-month rolling window.
